review: Recovery31 synchronized workload preparation and failure evidence

reviewerValidation.actualMac: Pending. Fourteen Darwin tests were skipped on Linux.

assessment.workloadChange: Three workers still touch 1536 MiB each, but now wait on a private stdin-byte barrier. The supervisor releases them only after all readiness acknowledgements, then runs the 60-second CPU/process-churn phase.
assessment.budgetChange: The readiness budget explicitly changes from 15 to 60 seconds. Its timer starts after launching the workers; the existing outer phase/job and resource guards also cover launch and cleanup.
assessment.evidence: The safe workload receipt retains fixed phase/allowlisted firstFailure code and kind, optional numeric errno, readiness count/elapsed, barrier release count, completed load duration, exact worker pre-cleanup exit status and post-cleanup return codes.
assessment.unknown: Unavailable exit observations remain null/unavailable. Resource unknown values remain null. Fixed controller phase/code identifies where the workload failed, not necessarily the internal reason for a worker exit.
assessment.cleanup: Only exact created children receive signals. Cleanup continues across child failures, closes both streams, preserves the original pending exception and retains cleanup operations/errors. The outer Runner still requires verified-gone process group and exact leader reap.
assessment.qualification: The outer gate rejects incomplete readiness/barrier/load duration, unknown samples, timeout attempts, insufficient measured RSS/CPU and unverified cleanup. It still requires the reviewed native helper backend.
assessment.unchanged: Recovery29 monitoring sources and Recovery30 SDK/argv sources and plan are byte-identical to their reviewed versions. Inventory timeout=3, three attempts/retry gaps, resource ceilings, ownership checks, SDK permissions/retention and artifact policy are unchanged.

resolvedFinding.resolution: When cleanup is the first failure, a fixed cleanup phase/code/kind is now stored before receipt publication and raising. An earlier primary failure remains unchanged. A real small workload/cleanup test injects a cleanup failure after recovery and verifies failure evidence, reaping and the raised Failure.

meaningfulTests: Actual worker remains alive behind the start barrier until release; EOF fails.
Actual small supervisor observes all workers ready, releases every barrier and reaps every child.
Readiness timeout and malformed/EOF readiness fail with phase/code and exact recovery.
Worker nonzero exit retains before-cleanup and after-reap exit codes.
Partial launch and earlier cleanup denial cannot skip other children or replace a primary failure.
Outer gate rejects incomplete barrier/load, resource unknown and unverified cleanup.
activationConditions: Bind and read back the seven reviewed files plus the rendered caller workflow at immutable commits; render only the fixture SHA placeholder.
Confirm an unused recovery31 branch, no prior run and no overlapping owned validation; preserve exact repository/ref/push/created/before-zero/attempt-one guards.
Fresh-check artifact12133086104 and acquire through the ordinary unexpired API route with all ZIP/TAR/tree/version and 600-second download guards intact.

Require actual Mac 289 passes with zero skips, verified SDK materialization, five fresh candidate passes with passed diagnostics, a complete synchronized workload with three ready/released/reaped workers, at least 60 seconds of load and the unchanged resource/sample thresholds.

Require successful known-child/background observations and safe terminal receipt with firstFailure/monitorFailure null and verified cleanup; review the terminal evidence before any long-trial decision.

run30Evidence.sdk: Official acquisition and SDK materialization/tree/version passed.
run30Evidence.candidateObservations: Six controlled passes with launcher argv0 text/canonical difference and exact count/tail/child orig_argv/current native executable/strict row inclusion.
run30Evidence.stress: Only six complete samples at the observed partial load; workload exited nonzero before its required completion.
run30Evidence.cause: UNKNOWN: old workload phase/code and pre-cleanup exit states were absent.

limitations: The synchronized setup and longer readiness budget are a new controlled experiment, not a proven explanation of Run30.
A passing short workload cannot establish multi-hour Rust monitoring stability, checkpoint eligibility or full host/XUL/native-authentication success.
Run27 inclusion failure, Run26/Run28 timeout shared cause and the original native-host exit remain unresolved historical observations.
